blocks.value: A wildcard (?) stands in for an unknown type when you don't need to name it. An unbounded wildcard <?> accepts any type at all:
An upper bounded wildcard restricts the unknown type to a given type or any of its subtypes, using extends. This method accepts a list of any kind of Number (Integer, Double, and so on):

A lower bounded wildcard restricts the unknown type to a given type or any of its supertypes, using super. This method accepts anything that can hold an Integer, whether the list is actually typed as Integer, Number, or Object:
